rca_of_issue: Bug: LocationCreate and LocationUpdate Pydantic models in /app/backend/server.py did not have 'timezone' field. When frontend (LocationsPage.jsx) submitted timezone in form data, FastAPI's Pydantic validation silently dropped it. Fix: Added timezone as Optional[str] with default 'Africa/Kampala' to LocationCreate and Optional[str] None to LocationUpdate.
